data.body:
Plan-review remediation round 2 (2026-08-21), against review rv9 (BLOCK; blocking E2, G6 x2, T8) — narration kept out of the description for the 8000-char admission cap.

- E2/T8 (no classification procedure; `withdrawn` had no trigger): the description now states one assignment rule per state, each keyed to a named signal — `still-present` = REGION_UNCHANGED or REGION_UNKNOWN, `addressed` = REGION_CHANGED, `withdrawn` = the prior item already carried a `standing` object — plus a worked PS2->PS4 example (the reviewer's 'specification by example' coaching move).
- G6 (merge_findings cannot compute the state): confirmed against the tree — merge_findings (workflow_ops.py:237) receives only finding lists via the code-review.yaml merge step, which wires base/round_a/round_b findings and nothing else. Classification moved to a new leaf llm/code_review/carry_forward.py, which holds the prior payload's `deps` map and calls region_gate.region_for_finding; merge_findings now receives already-resolved items as data through a new optional `standing_findings` workflow input.
- G6 (no termination argument vs plan-review's material-changed guard): `addressed` is the per-finding analogue of _material_changed (plan_review/sidecar.py:396) and `withdrawn` makes the carry ONE-SHOT, so the chain terminates after a single patchset even when the cited region keeps churning.
- Advisory (unresolvable signal has no fallback; STANDING_CAP unspecified): REGION_UNKNOWN defaults to `still-present` — safe because the posture clamp means a carried item can only lower a decision — and STANDING_CAP is pinned at 12, matching plan-review's RECALL_CAP (plan_review/sidecar.py:368).
- Verified against the tree while remediating: the memory key is only available at gate_dispatch._assemble_code_review_run / finalize (request.session_id / request.change_id), which is why resolution happens there rather than inside the workflow; region_for_finding is file-content-hash granularity (region_gate.py:31-43), so no line-level 'cited lines deleted' claim survives in the plan; test stubs monkeypatch rebar.llm.code_review.sidecar.latest_code_review_result BY STRING at test_code_review_region_gate.py:85,:183,:201 and test_code_review_gate_session.py:484, so the reader's added `revision` key must be added to those stubs.
- Line numbers refreshed against origin/main: latest_code_review_result sidecar.py:354, apply_region_gated_floor workflow_ops.py:641, merge_findings :237, code_review_verify_inputs :270, pass3_decide decide.py:631, plan-review recall injection pass1.py:489.
